hook: SWE-bench Verified went from 4% to 80.9% in under three years. Same Claude Sonnet 4.5 scored 43.2% on SWE-agent v1 and 59.8% on Cline autonomous — the scaffolding around the model now matters as much as the model itself. OpenHands (formerly OpenDevin) is the most active MIT-licensed platform and its CodeAct loop executes Python actions directly in a sandbox instead of JSON tool calls. The headline numbers hide a methodological issue: 161 of 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks require only a 1–2 line change, and SWE-bench Pro (10+ line tasks) sits at 23–59% for the same frontier models.
